1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier using a processing device; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processing device; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present using the processing device; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present utilizing the processing device.

3. (Currently Amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising: - generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the advertising reference code is not present using the processing device.

4. (Currently Amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising: - providing the traffic message for broadcast to navigation systems using a broadcasting device.

6. (Currently Amended) The method according to Claim 1 further comprising, prior to assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code: - determining whether the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast using the processing device; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code when the traffic message is a message of every predefined number of messages for broadcast utilizing the processing device.

14. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisement messages using location reference codes comprising: - assessing a location reference code of a location description using a processing device; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code using the processing device; - generating an advertising message having the advertising reference code using the processing device; and - providing the advertising message for broadcast to navigation systems using a broadcasting device.

29. (Currently Amended) A method of providing advertisements using location reference codes comprising: - receiving a message from a traffic supplier using a receiving device, wherein the message contains a location reference and an advertising reference code; - assessing at least one advertisement associated with the advertising reference code using the processing device; and - presenting the at least one advertisement to a user of the navigation system at a location based on the location reference code using a display device.

42. (Currently Amended) A memory comprising a data structure of traffic message, wherein the data structure comprises: a first field having a location reference code associated with a location description on a road segment assigned by a traffic message supplier; and a second field having an advertising reference code associated with the location reference of the first field, wherein the advertising reference code is associated with at least one advertisement for output on a navigation system utilizing an output device.
